page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8581C processors. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 192 vCPUs mapped to 96 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 1488.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 7.75 GB of memory per core. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the top tier for multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test yields a top-tier score of 165304.41, while the single-core performance is average at 2155.98. Memory read bandwidth reaches a top-tier 12801.04 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 574.78 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark database operations also rank in the top tier, demonstrating strong capability in handling concurrent data-intensive tasks.

This instance is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive memory density combined with high-throughput parallel processing, though the lack of local storage requires external block storage solutions. It is ideally suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, high-throughput web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression pipelines.
